label: Milk minerals
note: A calcium supplement and fortifier made from the minerals of whey, not from milk powder.

about.text: The calcium and phosphate of whey, collected as a powder. Heated whey permeate drops its calcium phosphate, which is washed, dried and sold as a milk calcium for fortifying foods and supplements.

links.name: University of Waikato: Calcium phosphate precipitation from whey permeate

facts.v: Free Ca2+ in the permeate decides how much calcium phosphate comes out (Waikato thesis); pH, citrate, lactate, sulfate and the Ca : P ratio change it
